tier: A — deterministic source behavior
title: Telemetry delivery can accumulate unbounded pending MainActor tasks
status: Source-proven queueing behavior; live growth magnitude requires macOS profiling
basis: The recurring telemetry delivery path creates a fresh unstructured MainActor task that captures the update payload. No pending-task/latest-value gate is visible in the surrounding source. When production outruns MainActor consumption, queued tasks and their captured snapshots accumulate until serviced.
validation: Instrument produced, scheduled, applied, dropped/coalesced, and maximum pending depth; stall MainActor for three seconds while telemetry continues.

tier: A — deterministic source behavior
title: Each gauge MTKView owns an independent command queue/pipeline and recurring render cadence
status: Source-proven resource topology; device-specific CPU/GPU cost requires Instruments
basis: The native gauge view/representable constructs Metal command-queue and pipeline resources in its per-view object graph and configures recurring drawing. Cost therefore scales with the number of simultaneously instantiated gauge views.
validation: Record live MTKView, MTLCommandQueue, pipeline-state, and GPU work for 1, 10, 100, and the full gauge count; repeat after hiding and dismissing the screen.

tier: A — deterministic source behavior
title: Gauge update path allocates replacement Metal buffers
status: Source-proven allocation site
basis: The SwiftUI/native update path reaches makeBuffer, so model updates allocate a new MTLBuffer rather than writing to stable storage. At telemetry/display cadence this is deterministic allocation churn.
validation: Use Allocations filtered to MTLBuffer creation and compare with a persistent-buffer implementation updated through contents().

status: Source-proven recurring invalidation

validation: Use SwiftUI Instruments to compare body-update counts with the timeline removed or scoped to the smallest animated primitive.
